video_title: “My Goal Is To Impact The Game And Make Winning Plays.” | Joan Beringer Postgame Sound | 11.23.26

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on his defensive impact and versatility
quotes.excerpt: When those days you can't really score, you have to find another way to impact the game.
quotes.quote: I just try to play hard. When those days you can't really score, you have to find another way to impact the game. I just try to play my best defense, be active, and just play hard.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer on his approach to nights where his shot is not falling: I just try to play my best defense, be active, and just play hard.

structured.context: Joan Beringer discusses his approach to impacting the game when his scoring is not effective.

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on the team's collective focus on rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I think it's a mindset and I think we do it well.
quotes.quote: I think it's just a group. We try to help each other and that's the best way to rebound the ball and it's just go consistently. I think it's a mindset and I think we do it well.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer says the Timberwolves rebounding success comes down to a collective mindset: We try to help each other and that is the best way to rebound the ball.

structured.context: Joan Beringer explains the team's collective mindset regarding rebounding.

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on his goal to impact winning
quotes.excerpt: He said just for me to find a way to impact the game, impact winning.
quotes.quote: Before the season starts, the team coach came to me and he gave me a letter and he said just for me to find a way to impact the game, impact winning. So it's just what I try to do every game. Even if I don't score, I just try to impact for the win and I think it's just my mindset every game.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer reveals his coach gave him a letter before the season with a specific challenge: Find a way to impact the game and impact winning, even if I do not score.

structured.context: Joan Beringer reflects on the coaching staff's advice to focus on impacting winning rather than just scoring.

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on learning from Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert
quotes.excerpt: It's such a blessing for me and I can learn from the best.
quotes.quote: It's such a blessing for me and I can learn from the best. I really appreciate Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert. They just help me defensively and I learn a lot from them every night.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer on learning from Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert: It is such a blessing for me and I can learn from the best. They help me defensively and I learn a lot from them every night.

structured.context: Joan Beringer expresses appreciation for learning defensive skills from teammates Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert.

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on his relationship with Jaden McDaniels
quotes.excerpt: I just love Jaden and I love his game.
quotes.quote: I just love Jaden and I love his game and I just love how we play. He can do anything and I try to visualize that too, because I try to be the best version of myself. I try to visualize him a lot in practice and I just try to stay around to see what he does.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer says he tries to visualize Jaden McDaniels during practice to help his own development: I try to be the best version of myself and I try to visualize him a lot.

structured.context: Joan Beringer discusses how he studies and tries to emulate Jaden McDaniels during practice.

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on the importance of running the floor
quotes.excerpt: Even if I don't receive the ball, I think I can open my teammates.
quotes.quote: Even if I don't receive the ball, I think I can open my teammates. So I think right now is the best thing I can do, running and play hard. It's just what I do and who I am.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer on the value of running the floor even without the ball: Even if I do not receive the ball, I think I can open my teammates. It is just what I do and who I am.

structured.context: Joan Beringer explains the value of running the floor to create space for his teammates.

quotes.quote: Probably my footwork, just moving fast and moving fast and just yeah, I think it helps with that.
